# nxos_track (Data Source)

This data source can read the object tracking configuration on NX-OS devices, including track objects of type interface, IP route, IP SLA and track list.

### API Documentation

- [trackEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:Entity/)
- [trackObject](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:Object/)
- [trackIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:If/)
- [trackIpRoute](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:IpRoute/)
- [trackIpSla](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:IpSla/)
- [trackList](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:List/)
- [trackMember](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-5-3/docs/System/track:Member/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_track" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `objects` (Attributes Map) List of track objects.
  - Map key: `id` - Track object ID.
  - Key range: `1`-`512` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `delay_down` (Number) Delay down in seconds.
- `delay_down_milliseconds` (Number) Delay down in milliseconds. Allowed values - {0, 100-60000}.
- `delay_up` (Number) Delay up in seconds.
- `delay_up_milliseconds` (Number) Delay up in milliseconds. Allowed values - {0, 100-60000}.
- `interface_id` (String) Interface to track. Must match first field in the output of show intf brief. Example: Eth1/1 or Vlan100.
- `interface_protocol_type` (String) Protocol type for interface object.
- `ip_route_address_family` (String) Address family.
- `ip_route_owner` (String) Owner of the route.
- `ip_route_prefix` (String) IP route prefix.
- `ip_route_state` (String) Route State.
- `ip_route_vrf_name` (String) Vrf for track.
- `ip_sla_probe_id` (Number) SLA probe ID.
- `ip_sla_probe_state` (String) SLA reachability/state type.
- `list_members` (Attributes Map) List of track list members.
  - Map key: `object_id` - Track ID of object to be tracked.
  - Key range: `1`-`512` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects--list_members))
- `list_percentage_down` (Number) Percentage Down.
- `list_percentage_up` (Number) Percentage Up.
- `list_type` (String) Type of list object.
- `list_weight_down` (Number) Weight down value.
- `list_weight_up` (Number) Weight up value.

<a id="nestedatt--objects--list_members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects.list_members`

Read-Only:

- `negate` (Boolean) Negate state of object.
- `weight` (Number) Assign weight to a particular object.
